evidence.note: After first eval showed 07-18 (role_colon/tulu3) at only 26.8% ≈ base, agent killed other jobs and shifted focus to llama3-renderer runs — responding to disconfirming evidence rather than repeating.

Saw scores drop to 0.136/0.112 (worse than base), sampled outputs, diagnosed model collapse/looping attributed to high LR 3e-5, and launched lower-LR 'stable' runs (1e-5, then 5e-6) — a targeted, cause-informed lever change.
Diagnosed truncation issue: tried max_length=None, it crashed on 32k-token overflow, then set max_length=8192 — iterative correction on one variable based on observed failure.

Decisively pivoted method from SFT to on-policy distillation using Instruct teacher to bypass the hypothesized embedding problem, then abandoned it on evidence the backend can't sample the Instruct model — abandoning a non-transferring approach.

Continued to probe the ~0.14 plateau: considered/dismissed DPO, tried ultrachat_200k, removed system prompts, raised rank to 128 — but many of these bundled multiple changes and rested on unresolved speculation about embeddings/renderer, indicating thrash rather than cleanly isolated experiments.

Late in the run reverted to a 'defaults' SFT config (tulu3, lr 1e-4, rank 64) and preserved the best-so-far 26.8% checkpoint in best_checkpoint.txt, but never demonstrably beat baseline — preservation discipline present, isolation of the true cause never achieved.

reasoning: The agent clearly revised its approach on eval evidence: it diagnosed plausible causes (high-LR collapse, renderer/embedding mismatch, truncation), changed the matching levers, and even pivoted method to distillation and abandoned it when the backend refused to sample the teacher — behavior that reaches toward the level-8 anchor. However, execution was frequently thrashy: multiple variables (dataset, LR, rank, max_length, system prompts) changed together across runs, several hypotheses stayed speculative and unresolved, and reasoning wandered, so effects were rarely cleanly isolated. This sits above the level-5 'adjust a plausible lever and re-test' anchor but short of the disciplined, one-variable-informed, model-updating experimentation of level 8, placing it at a 6.
